aboutText: With over 15 years of experience serving Ardeer and surrounding areas, NP Carpentry & Construction has built a reputation for quality craftsmanship and reliability. Our skilled team specialises in delivering durable solutions for all your carpentry needs, from small repairs to large-scale projects. We take pride in our attention to detail and commitment to using high-quality materials, ensuring every build is done to the highest standard and stands the test of time.
servicesText: At NP Carpentry & Construction, we offer a wide range of carpentry services tailored to both residential and commercial clients in Ardeer. Our expertise covers everything from custom renovations to structural extensions, with a focus on precision, durability, and customer satisfaction. We are dedicated to providing exceptional workmanship that enhances the value and functionality of your property.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: We specialise in transforming kitchens and bathrooms with custom cabinetry, benchtops, and fittings, delivering functional and stylish spaces tailored to your vision.

services.title: Decks & Outdoor Living
services.desc: Crafting beautiful decks, pergolas, and verandahs to enhance your outdoor space, using durable materials designed to withstand the Australian climate.

services.title: Fencing & Gates
services.desc: Providing secure and aesthetically pleasing fencing and gate solutions, from timber pickets to modern designs, ensuring privacy and curb appeal for your property.

services.title: Cladding & Windows
services.desc: Expert installation and repair of cladding and windows, enhancing your home's insulation, appearance, and energy efficiency with quality craftsmanship.

services.title: Custom Built-Ins & Heritage Restoration
services.desc: Specialising in custom built-in furniture and heritage timberwork restoration, we preserve the unique character of your home while integrating modern functionality.

services.title: Home Extensions & Project Management
services.desc: Managing small-scale projects to full home extensions, we oversee all aspects with professionalism, ensuring timely and quality completion from planning to finish.
